svg.text: Side view. ~300 kg, 1.8 m long, built from regolith by robots like itself, plus one avionics module from Earth.
From the Moon profile in vnmach/body.py
cast iron, iron-silicon · made on the Moon
drawn iron wire · made on the Moon
Fe-Si laminations, Al coils, glass fibre · made on the Moon
cast iron · made on the Moon
Fe-Si tubes, aluminium · made on the Moon
aluminium, glass insulation · made on the Moon
97% made on the Moon by mass; only the avionics come from Earth.
Motors and reducers come in pairs:
one per wheel hub (4), one per arm joint (4).
Joints turn in plain bushings: iron shafts
in cast-basalt sleeves, so no metal-on-metal
The tether brings 100–300 V DC from the
power mast: no battery to make or ship.
